feature: ADR-0102 Linux owned configuration directory notification and bounded debounce

linux.watcher_scenario: 60s periodic interval / 5s observation, own create_new replacement+atomic rename automatic Accepted2, write automatic Rejected2, repeated invalid explicit request Unchanged, restored accepted bytes automatic Unchanged/no gen3, removal automatic ReadFailed, own parent PID SIGINT / actual0 Cooperative / same source reaped; synthetic Engine/session, Missing/recoveryfalse/successfalse

initial_failures: Initial Clippy rejected manual_is_multiple_of and new FFI item following test module; replaced standard method and moved FFI before tests, production lints unchanged. Initial tool output remains in session, final full validation logs recorded.
abi: Two fixed scalar/pathname inotify calls only in private ioctl.rs, owned CLOEXEC/NONBLOCK descriptor; C oracle adds header offsets/flags/masks/signatures; native tests operate own dirs/files and proc/self/fdinfo only. No dependencies added.

windows.scope: Linux-only backend/source/notification API; earlier shared CLI and native validation remain pending approval quota issue.

limitations: Hints are not content/authentication/consumer/progress/activation; only original timely valid Accepted advances baseline.
Register once on first existing background file job after signals and spawn, not on control thread. Any failure/loss falls back to original periodic reads without retry registration.
One notification read at most 4096 bytes per host tick; unrelated files filtered. Overflow rescan, directory loss disables.
Quiet period200ms with continuous-hint1s scheduling cap; busy job/transaction/unread notification may defer actual read. Manual flag bypasses debounce but cannot extend transaction.
Parent replacement or symlink target outside watched directory depends on periodic fallback; no controlled watch re-registration yet.
No hard filesystem/allocator/thread/join/close time bound. Close retains original running job, discards late snapshot and owned notice when reaped; Drop not Exit/cleanup proof.
Cached config_notify_error None is not notification completeness/liveness proof. No active-loop stdio; real-time notifications/manual command still unfinished.
Unit simulation and synthetic actual-main Engine/Active evidence do not validate real console/keyboard capture/recovery. No real VT/evdev/uinput/input/driver/install actions.
Windows adapter/native validation, real hardware and full original goal remain unfinished.
